gray_rule: sum RGB over each 4x4 block, weighted sum, add 2048, shift right 12
resize_rule: direct from base; center-aligned Q8 coordinates floored and clamped; bilinear Q16 sum, add 32768, shift right 16
quantize_rounding: nearest, ties away from zero; reject overflow, no saturation
sqrt_rule: unsigned integer floor sqrt, 17 restoring iterations for 34-bit input
low_contrast_rule: D = 484 * sum_square - sum * sum; reject D <= 484*484*100
stage_compare: reject signed leaf sum < signed stage threshold; equality passes
stump_layout: rect0[19:0], rect1[39:20], rect2[59:40] each x/y/w/h 5 bits LSB first; mode[61:60]; node signed[77:62]; left signed[95:78]; right signed[113:96]; [119:114] zero
stage_layout: weak_count[7:0]; signed threshold[25:8] Q12 after float32 stageThreshold - float32(1e-5); [39:26] zero; first weak index is cumulative count
grouping: pairwise equivalence / union-find, eps=1/5; minNeighbors=5 requires >=6 raw rectangles; mean coordinates nearest ties up; nested suppression; overflow invalidates sample
